verdict.rationale: HeyGen documents a 'camera-directed' cinematic avatar video type with multi-shot prompts, cinematic motion, and scene direction, so creators can direct the camera through text prompts rather than accept a default. The evidence never shows that specific moves (pan, zoom, orbit, static) can be named and reliably honored, and the wide/medium/close-up framing claim covers shot size, not camera motion. Missing for 10: documented explicit camera-move controls or parameters (pan/zoom/orbit/static), evidence that prompted motion is followed precisely, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a creator, I can direct camera moves (pan, zoom, orbit, static) instead of accepting whatever motion the model picks
